pattern.description: Apply RF level settings via MMIO register writes followed by a command trigger sequence (write 2 then 3 to command reg 0x40342034).
pattern.template_c: void rf_level_apply_n(struct rf_regs *r) { /* set RF params */ *((volatile uint32_t *)0x40342084U) = cfg_a; *((volatile uint32_t *)0x403416e0U) = cfg_b; /* trigger */ (void)*((volatile uint32_t *)0x40342034U); *((volatile uint32_t *)0x40342034U) = 0x2U; (void)*((volatile uint32_t *)0x40342034U); *((volatile uint32_t *)0x40342034U) = 0x3U; }
